title: Fano gauge untwister
summary: Fano gauges move the location of the point-mass tilt but preserve the multiset {240,232,232,224,224,224,224}. No balanced 228/229 representative exists inside this relabeling class.
honesty_boundary: Finite Fano GL(3,2) relabeling orbit only; does not rule out a different physical incidence design outside this charge class.
